questions.q: What core problem does accounting exist to solve for a business?
options: It gives the business a reliable, structured memory of its transactions so questions can be answered on demand
It lets a business avoid paying any taxes
It replaces the need for a bank account
It only exists because governments require it
questions.explain: A business generates far too many transactions to track from memory. Accounting records, classifies, and summarizes them into something trustworthy.

questions.q: Which of these groups would rely on financial information to decide whether to extend MORE credit to a business?
options: The company's competitors
Random members of the public
Lenders and creditors
Nobody — lenders never look at financial records
questions.explain: Lenders and creditors read financial information to judge whether a business can repay what it borrows before extending more credit.

questions.q: What is the best way to describe bookkeeping?
options: A legal requirement that has nothing to do with accounting
The broad discipline that includes judgment calls about revenue recognition
A synonym for preparing a tax return
The mechanical, day-to-day recording of individual transactions
questions.explain: Bookkeeping is the mechanical recording layer. Accounting is the broader discipline that includes bookkeeping plus classification and summarization.

questions.q: Why do financial records need consistent, shared rules rather than each business just keeping notes however it likes?
options: Because computers cannot read handwritten notes
Because many different readers — owners, lenders, regulators — rely on the same records for different decisions, and need to trust what the numbers mean
Because every business uses the exact same software
There is no real need for shared rules; this is just a tradition
questions.explain: Shared rules exist so that a lender or investor reading one company's books can trust the numbers mean the same thing as another company's books.

questions.q: Why does an Oracle Fusion Financials consultant specifically need to understand what accounting is for, not just how to click through the software?
options: Because the software is, underneath its screens, a configurable machine for capturing, applying rules to, and summarizing the same transactions this course describes
Because Oracle Fusion has no connection to accounting concepts
Because consultants are never asked questions about how a report works
Because accounting knowledge is only needed for the final exam
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion Financials automates the exact job described in this lesson. Without the underlying accounting model, a consultant can configure screens without understanding why they matter.
